operations.value: Fighter traits (sys-traits). Crusader-Kings-style personality, physique and history traits; every name and text is original. Spec: docs/design/_drafts/03-fighter-lifecycle.md, M1.1 changes in docs/design/_drafts/m1.1/progression.md. Stat ids are the combat.json attribute ids (str agi pac tgh pre stamina arc spi wil cmp ldr awr dis). Each effect's 'owner' (see effectTypes) says who applies it: 'management' effects are applied by lifecycle/economy code before or outside the fight (stat adds arrive in the fight setup's effective stats and must not be re-applied); 'sim' effects are applied inside the fight by combat (sys-fight-traits, combat.json traitEffectAdapter; docs/design/03 boundary contract 3). Whole-point stat adds are capped at +/-3 per stat per trait (statAddCapPerTrait, TUNABLE). effectText must be updated by whoever changes a number. 'Development xN' in effectText means level-ups come N times as fast (XP per level divided by N). Fractions are decimals; the loader converts them to basis points.

M1.1: divides XP per level (levels.json xpPerLevel traitDev). group physical and mental are blended by the class's physical rating-weight share (wPhys); group all applies to both. Counts while the fighter's humanAge at the start of the level is in range.
Multiplies XP per round and bench XP (floor after all multipliers).
Multiplies the strength a of training emphasis: how hard level-up offers lean toward the emphasised group (0 = emphasis has no effect).
Club-mates with humanAge <= 23 level up faster: their XP per level is divided by the mentoring multiplier (captain grade and at most 2 trait mentors per club; all mentoring capped at x1.15).

value._doc: M1.1 (owner T005): a level-up can offer a trait (levels.json offers.traitOffer, traitOfferPool). A chosen trait is held with source 'level'. It is checked like a roll (not held; opposites, excludes and exclusiveGroup both ways; maxPerCategory) and never makes a fighter exceed maxRolledAndLearned rolled + learned traits or maxTotalTraits. Learned traits keep their own loss rules (Hot Blood may still mellow). They are not counted by the rolled-trait 80/20 soak band.

operations.value: +2 stamina. In fights: +8% damage after 30 s of a round.
